feeds.title: watercolours by rachel blog
feeds.description: My web page shows some of my original watercolour paintings, card sets and prints which are for sale. My name is Rachel Toll and I am a watercolour artist based in Devon, England. I love painting and gain much inspiration from the landscapes, wildlife and coasts of Devon and Cornwall.

feeds.title: Original Watercolours by Tim Wilmot
feeds.description: Watercolor paintings from UK artist Tim Wilmot. As I paint them, I upload them with some watercolour hints and tips along the way. Plus get the latest information on any watercolour courses and workshops I am doing in the future.

feeds.title: Alan Reed's Painting Blog
feeds.description: Alan Reed's Painting Blog with tips and demonstrations how to paint in watercolours and oils.

feeds.title: Watercolours
feeds.description: Here you will see my watercolour and oil painting and drawing. Also my painting stories, and a online shop where you can buy art. Enjoy your visit.

feeds.title: Catherine Beale everything watercolour
feeds.description: I am a painter specialising in light-filled watercolours. Everything watercolour: award-winning portraits & landscapes created by her own 'gravity painting' method which she explains to art groups & in workshops.

feeds.title: Watercolours With Life
feeds.description: International watercolorist Jean Haines SWA is well known for her passion for working in her favourite medium, watercolour. Jean is a member of the SWA, Society for Women Artists, and won the Anthony J Lester Award in 2009 during the SWA Annual Exhibition where her work was likened to Joseph Crawhalls from the famous Glasgow Boys.

feeds.title: The Watercolour Log
feeds.description: Peter Ward's attempt to become a good artist painting in watercolour, experiences along the way and discussion of all things connected with it.

feeds.title: Jem Bowden Watercolor Blog
feeds.description: My painting life consists of two mutually beneficial roles, as both a professional, practising watercolour painter, and a teacher of watercolour painting. The great watercolourists have shown that this medium is all we should need. In theory it can be simple, but watercolour has its own ideas…

feeds.title: Caroline Henricksen Blog
feeds.description: I've always been interested in drawing and painting. At university I studied graphic design and illustration, specialising in scientific illustration. I particularly enjoy botanical and zoological painting in watercolour. I am often to be found painting wild flora, fruits, lichen and funghi from the hedgerow and woods of my local area. I'm drawn by the intricate detail revealed by the magnifying glass.
